editorial.meta_description: The Management Accounting exam CA-MA is retired. Candidates should pursue the successor certification CACC2504 for their professional accounting requirements.
editorial.overview: The Management Accounting exam, formerly offered by CA ANZ, covered cost accounting, budgeting, and strategic performance measurement. This exam is retired as of 2021-06. It has been replaced by CACC2504. Candidates seeking certification in this field must now follow the path established for CACC2504, as CA-MA is no longer available for registration or completion.
editorial.who_should_take: This certification path is for accounting professionals and candidates pursuing membership with CA ANZ. Those aiming to demonstrate proficiency in management accounting principles should focus their efforts on the current requirements of CACC2504.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Focus your preparation on the curriculum for CACC2504. Concepts regarding cost behaviour, variance analysis, and strategic decision-making remain relevant, but you must align your study materials with the current syllabus of the successor exam. Do not attempt to prepare for the retired CA-MA exam. Utilize updated resources to master the specific objectives required for CACC2504.

domain_guidance.summary: This starting domain covers the detailed classification of various organizational costs and provides broad analysis of how these specific costs change dynamically in relation to different business activity levels and operational volumes.

This required domain focuses heavily on the careful preparation of operating and financial budgets while also providing detailed evaluation of variances between actual incurred expenses and established standard costs within the organization.

This practical domain addresses the important use of relevant financial information to properly support major management decisions and examines the widespread application of modern costing methods for optimal business operations.

This analytical domain involves the direct assessment of various responsibility centers and explores the effective use of specific performance metrics to properly evaluate overall organizational efficiency and departmental outcomes.

This final domain explores the strategic integration of detailed accounting data into long-term strategic planning frameworks and examines methods for driving sustainable business value creation across the enterprise.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: The CA-MA exam is retired and cannot be scheduled. Candidates should consult the CA ANZ website for current scheduling procedures and requirements for the successor exam, CACC2504.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The provided documentation does not specify the total number of questions for this retired assessment. Candidates should review current official guidelines for details regarding the updated successor path.
The passing score required to successfully pass this historical exam is established at 50 points. Note that this information pertains to the retired program version.
The scheduled duration of the exam is exactly 180 minutes under standard testing conditions. This timeframe applied when the assessment was actively administered to candidates.

faq.question_title: What is the cost of the exam?
faq.answer_text: The historical exam price is approximately $650. Because fees can vary significantly over time, candidates should always check the official CA ANZ website for current pricing information.

methodology.summary: This index was compiled by aggregating verified facts from CA ANZ documentation and official source materials regarding the retirement of CA-MA and the transition to CACC2504.
